cases.name: Katlyn Maria "Katie" Collman
cases.about: Her Find-a-Grave said Katie "was a fourth grade student at Crothersville Elementary. She attended the First Baptist Church of Crothersville where she was involved in the Awana program. Katie enjoyed playing outside, watching the Disney Channel, going into The Peoples Bank daily to get suckers, and was known for always being happy and having a big smile on her face."
cases.narrative: On 1/30/2005, State Police discovered her body in a waterway at nearby Cypress Lake, about 19 miles away from her home. Her hands were bound behind her back and she had been raped and then drowned.
